auth.label: API Key
auth.description: Insites API key sent with the api-key header. Manage it at https://app.insites.com/.

actions.name: get_audit
actions.description: Get the processing state and account-configured JSON result for one Insites audit.

includeDatasets.description: Whether to include additional datasets such as broken links.

availableVersions.description: Whether to include the IDs of available audit versions.

versionId.description: A specific audit version ID to retrieve.

staging.description: Whether to retrieve the staging audit associated with this business.

categories.description: Whether to include categories from the account overview layout.

percentiles.description: Whether to include percentile data for this business.

inputSchema.description: The audit and optional result sections to retrieve.

status.description: The request status returned by Insites.

reportStatus.description: The audit processing state returned by Insites.

anyOf.description: The account-configured Insites audit data returned for this website.

report.description: The account-configured Insites audit data returned for this website.

outputSchema.description: The current state and optional data for one Insites audit.

actions.name: get_llm_audit
actions.description: Get the LLM-optimized JSON result for one Insites audit with a compact AI-oriented payload.

inputSchema.description: The Insites audit to retrieve in LLM-optimized form.

status.description: The request status returned by Insites.

reportStatus.description: The audit processing state returned by Insites.

anyOf.description: The account-configured Insites audit data returned for this website.

report.description: The account-configured Insites audit data returned for this website.

outputSchema.description: The current state and optional data for one Insites audit.

actions.name: list_audits
actions.description: Search existing Insites audits with documented filters, ordering, and offset pagination.

operator.description: The comparison operator applied by Insites.

property.description: A documented audit property, such as domain, overall_score, or report_id.

targetValue.description: The value compared against the selected audit property.

filters.description: The filters applied to existing audits.

orderBy.description: The audit property used to order results.

limit.description: The maximum number of audit rows to return.

offset.description: The number of audit rows to skip.

includeHistoric.description: Whether to include old versions of business audits.

inputSchema.description: The filters, ordering, and pagination applied to the Insites audit search.

status.description: The request status returned by Insites.

items.description: The account-configured Insites audit data returned for this website.

actions.name: start_audit
actions.description: Start an Insites SEO and AEO website audit and return the report ID for status polling.

url.description: The website URL or hostname to analyze.

dedupeMethod.description: How Insites matches this request to an existing audit.

customerName.description: The customer name used when the audit is shared by email.

customerEmail.description: The customer email used when the audit is shared by email.

businessName.description: The business name used by local presence and review checks.

phone.description: The business phone number used by local presence and review checks.

address.description: The first line of the business address.

buildingNumber.description: The building number used to improve location accuracy.

street.description: The street name used to improve location accuracy.

city.description: The business city used to improve location accuracy.

state.description: The business state or county used to improve location accuracy.

postalCode.description: The business ZIP code or postcode.

countryCode.description: The ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 business country code.

latitude.description: The business latitude used to improve location accuracy.

longitude.description: The business longitude used to improve location accuracy.

googlePlaceId.description: The Google Place ID for the business.

products.description: Comma-separated products and services offered by the business.

locations.description: Comma-separated locations served by the business.

competitorReportId.description: An existing audit ID to which this audit should be added as a competitor.

pagesToAnalyze.description: The number of website pages to include in the audit.

generateKeywords.description: Whether Insites should automatically generate business keywords.

inputSchema.description: The website and optional business details used to start an Insites audit.

status.description: The request status returned by Insites.
